title: Current missing work and conformance gates
summary: Renderer parity remains partial; Direct Linux dev41 full source is now synchronized. Rasen Falcon v0.4.5 closes the public file-manifest gap, but public own-HTTPS/content/install gates and private LDAP/mTLS gates remain distinct and open.

items.work: Bind the current Web runtime to the v0.2 conformance fixture and produce a real normalized transcript.
Swing dev12 real head is 8/10. Add exact published ResourceRef consumption and positive-list observation subscription, then run the canonical transcript.
Direct Linux dev41 real head is 3/10. Add exact definition/resource identity, revision/renderedRevision, opaque workspaceContext, positive-list observation and deauthorisation/resync.
Recover/advance an Android renderer adapter from the documented dev7 semantic checkpoint; keep native host dev16 separate from renderer-version authority.
Closed by dev41: VERSION.txt now identifies wire_direct_linux v0.1-dev41.
Make all renderers consume exact Resource Editor/contract publications and fail closed for missing required resource authority; no generated customer copy.
Expose/readiness-stage evidence so transport connection is not conflated with synchronized semantic view.
Accept explicit production content/resource publication for the public apex; current v0.4.5 site output is candidate/noindex and not a production publication.
Combine the verified 16-file public source slice with an approved owned ooRexx HTTPS service/systemd unit, exact qualified runtime/Foreign Runtime closure, TLS identity and real readiness/e2e probes.
Nominate and use an approved non-production host via General Deployment; prove installed and running state before any production cutover.
Private NOC/Office only: merge/review LDAP dev23, install through owned Deployment, then prove live LDAPS principal attribution/revocation. Public apex must not wait on this gate.
Private NOC/Office: prove dedicated owned HTTPS + device mTLS + active LDAP principal + explicit HTTPS_LOGIN with no fallback identity store.
For authenticated Wire surfaces, prove a live HTTPS/WSS browser semantic roundtrip; durable deployment ingress alone is insufficient.
